assumptions.assumption: An IFRC appeal shows where the Red Cross and Red Crescent asked for money, not every place in need. Crises led by the ICRC (most armed conflicts), the UN or a government may have no IFRC appeal, so a country with no appeal is not a country without need.
assumptions.test: Stated on the page and in the feed note. Tested each run since the HDX HAPI lane (18 Nov 2026): the page lists countries with a current UN-coordinated plan and no current IFRC appeal.

assumptions.assumption: IFRC GO's amounts and status are current. Many appeals stay marked Active long after their end date (205 of 366 on 16 Nov 2026; the oldest started in 2012).
assumptions.test: Every appeal carries past_end_date. The feed, totals and funding chart leave those out; the page counts and lists them. Review the count after each collect.

assumptions.assumption: WHO publishes a Disease Outbreak News notice after it has verified an event, often weeks after the member state's notification, so a notice dates WHO's publication, not the outbreak.
assumptions.test: Untestable from the API alone; the notice text states the notification date, which this program does not keep (WHO's terms).

assumptions.assumption: WHO's notice titles keep the form '<disease> - <place>' (or a comma) closely enough to read the place, and relief/places.py knows WHO's country names.
assumptions.test: Every collect counts notices whose stated place was not recognised (extra.who.unread_places) and gives each such item coverage_fraction 0. On 16 Nov 2026 all 42 published notices parsed, and every one of the 200 read whose title states a place.

assumptions.assumption: OCHA FTS's funding figure for a plan is the funding reported to FTS against it. Funding given outside the plan, or not reported, is not counted, so a low funded share can understate what reached the response.
assumptions.test: Stated in every plan item's summary. FTS's Not specified rows (money outside any plan) are counted in extra.hapi.left_out, not published.

assumptions.assumption: The number of reports ReliefWeb posts on a disaster or a country measures reporting attention by ReliefWeb's content partners, not need or severity. A quiet crisis can be under-reported.
assumptions.test: Stated in every ReliefWeb item's summary. Reports with no single main country (ReliefWeb's World) are counted in extra.reliefweb.not_a_country.

assumptions.assumption: A country's plan is comparable with last year's plan for it, so a change in people in need reflects the situation. Methods change between Humanitarian Needs Overviews (the 2026 cycle narrowed many plans), so a fall can be a change of scope.
assumptions.test: RL-IND-3 marks only rises of 25% or more; the page shows each change with both years' figures.
